QuestInfo.name: [Limina] The Giant Appears
QuestInfo.0: The moment Orchid takes off, the Genesis Crux starts shuddering. It isn't until you defeat Guard Captain Darknell that Orchid tells you Neinheart's waiting to speak to you aboard the White Spear Ship Deck in #bEnd of the World 1-2#k.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart asks you to aid in the battle on deck. Defeat #bAscendion#k in #bEnd of the World 1-4#k or #bEnd of the World 1-5#k.
QuestInfo.2: You defended the ship admirably, just as Neinheart requested. Now you need to speak with Neinheart in #bEnd of the World 1-1#k.

default.0: Defeat #bAscendion#k in #bEnd of the World 1-4#k or #bEnd of the World 1-5#k.
